LanguageData.BOR_Signals_Contact_Desc: Someone is broadcasting to this analyzer. Choose a colonist to answer.
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_ShuttleWaiting: A shuttle is waiting for you.
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_NoLandingSpot: There is no open, roofless space near the analyzer for a shuttle to land.
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_TalkToPilotDesc: Send a colonist to hear the pilot's offer: a data drive for {0} sunsteel. The shuttle leaves in {1}.
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_ArrivalText: [PLACEHOLDER] A shuttle is answering the strange signals and landing near your analyzer. Its pilot wants to talk.
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_Greeting: {PAWN_labelShort} hears a faint buzzing in their ears, followed by a click.\n\n“Salutations, Rimworlder. There is a fine opportunity here. Do you wish to pursue it?”
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_WantMeToCome: “I’m quite busy, but far be it from me to impede progress. In order for you to take hold of this opportunity, I need to bring it to you. Will you give me your coordinates freely? Would you like me to come?”
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_PilotOffer: {PAWN_labelShort} cannot see his face, but he sounds like a jolly enough fellow.\n\n“It’s all here for you in this data drive. The whole of the universe and every Rimworld throughout space and time, squeezed right here into this little drive – and all I need from you is sunsteel. {0} units of sunsteel. That’s right. For the low, low price of {0} sunsteel, the answer to life, the universe, and everything, will be yours.”
LanguageData.BOR_Signals_Farewell: “Oh, well now. I’m sorry to hear that. Like I told you before – I’m a very busy man. And now you’ve wasted my time.”
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Contact_Desc: {0}: someone is broadcasting to this analyzer. Choose a colonist to answer.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_NoLandingSpot: There is no open, roofless space in your home area for their shuttles to land.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_ShuttleLocked: Locked while its crew is still fighting.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_RewardFound: Found a {0} in the shuttle's hold.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Signal_Greeting:
{PAWN_labelShort} hears a faint buzzing in their ears, followed by a click.

“It’s {IMPERSONATED}. What ya calling here fer?”

{PAWN_labelShort} feels like something is off. Why does the voice sound so … disjointed?
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Signal_AskReply: “What’chya need one of those fer? Need to move those pesky haderoth particles, eh, lil guy? What kind of artillery ya got over there? How many Colonists?”
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Signal_GiveInfoReply: “Oh, sure, sure. We got that fer ya. And we can get it to ya faster than anyone else. What’s yer 20?”
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Broadcasts_Stage1: {PAWN_labelShort} hears a buzzing followed by a click.\n\nThere is puffing, sniffling, and grunting coming through on the frequency. No one speaks.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Broadcasts_Stage2: The puffing and grunting gets louder. Moans begin to come through, though most of it is hard to decipher on account of the static. It goes quiet for a few seconds before {PAWN_labelShort} hears a wet, loud thud.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Broadcasts_Stage3: Moans come faster and louder, melding with the sound of someone breathing heavily. The moans repeat, over and over, until it sounds like a low, consistent humming. The hum grows in {PAWN_labelShort}’s ears, then deeper still, settling behind their eyes and rattling through their ribs. {PAWN_labelShort} can feel it.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_Broadcasts_Stage4: The hum abruptly stops. {PAWN_labelShort} can hear wet lips open wide -- “There you are...”
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_ArrivalText: [PLACEHOLDER] Shuttles of {FACTION_name} are landing in your colony. Their crews are coming out armed.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_ArrivalText: A lone tenebral of {FACTION_name} has come for you.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_SlaughterText: Your meddling caused {0} to be slaughtered by Tenebral Vanquishers.
LanguageData.BOR_Raid_DefeatedText: [PLACEHOLDER] The raiders are beaten. Their shuttles are yours to deconstruct, and one of them is carrying something valuable.
